workspace_id.description: workspace_id is the workspace id value for this contract.

completed_this_week.description: completed_this_week is the completed this week value for this contract.

in_progress_tasks.description: in_progress_tasks is the in progress tasks value for this contract.

my_tasks.description: my_tasks is the my tasks value for this contract.

open_tasks.description: open_tasks is the open tasks value for this contract.

overdue_tasks.description: overdue_tasks is the overdue tasks value for this contract.

actual_hours.description: actual_hours is the actual hours value for this contract.

archived.description:
Whether the task is archived. Archived tasks are excluded from default
list and board views but stay readable by id. Absent means false, as
with every other non-nullable scalar in this message.

assignee_id.description: assignee_id is the assignee id value for this contract.

assignee_initials.description: Two-letter uppercase initials derived from assignee_name. Empty if unassigned.

assignee_name.description: Assignee display name. Empty if unassigned.

completed_at.description: completed_at is the completed at value for this contract.

created_at.description: created_at is when the record was created.

cycle_id.description: Cycle (sprint) this task belongs to, if any.

decision_note.description: One-line decision log. Empty if none recorded.

dependencies.description:
Task ids this task depends on. Read-only projection; write through the
addTaskDependency / removeTaskDependency RPCs.

description.description: description is the description value for this contract.

due_date.description: due_date is the due date value for this contract.

effort_minutes.description:
Quick effort estimate in minutes. Null when no estimate is set. The
write path treats 0 as a clear, so a stored 0 does not occur.

estimated_hours.description: estimated_hours is the estimated hours value for this contract.

focus_pin.description:
Whether the *calling* user has pinned this task to their Today view.
Resolved per request from flow_task_focus_pins; never a shared task flag.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the resource.

identifier.description:
Human-readable identifier like "FLOW-42" (project code + sequence).
Display projection populated by the backend on list/detail reads; safe
to leave at zero value on writes.

labels.description: labels is the labels value for this contract.

milestone_id.description: Milestone this task rolls up to, if any.

owner_id.description: owner_id identifies the tenant that owns the resource.

parent_task_id.description: parent_task_id is the parent task id value for this contract.

priority.description: priority is the priority value for this contract.

project_color.description: Project color hex for inline badges on cross-project lists.

project_id.description: project_id is the project id value for this contract.

project_name.description: Project name (denormalised from flow_projects.name) for list views.

reporter_id.description: reporter_id is the reporter id value for this contract.

section_id.description: Section bucket within a project (e.g. "Backlog", "Sprint 5"). Empty if unbucketed.

sort_order.description: sort_order is the sort order value for this contract.

start_date.description: start_date is the start date value for this contract.

status.description: status is the current lifecycle state.

subtask_count.description: Number of direct subtasks. Powers the "N subtasks" pill on task rows.

title.description: title is the title value for this contract.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the record was last updated.

waiting_on.description: Free-text blocker label. Empty if nothing is blocking.

workspace_id.description: workspace_id is the workspace id value for this contract.

schema.description: workspace_id is the workspace id value for this contract.
